STABILITY_CRITERION.OPTION_A_absolute: freeze a numeric tolerance before reading — requires inventing a number from one point. NOT RECOMMENDED.

OPTION_B_relative_baseline.idea: make the criterion RELATIVE instead of absolute. Refetch one LONG-LAG archived session (e.g. a 2022 date, archived at lag ~900d) to measure the residual revision rate of data that is unambiguously settled. That becomes the SETTLED REFERENCE. The criterion is then: the smallest registered maturity M whose revision metric is not materially above the settled reference.
OPTION_B_relative_baseline.cost: ONE additional paid diagnostic refetch, eligible IMMEDIATELY (no waiting)
OPTION_B_relative_baseline.advantage: no number is invented; the corpus supplies its own baseline

STABILITY_CRITERION.RECOMMENDATION: Option B, and freeze the full comparison rule before any T+30 result is read
